title: docs(pm-dispatch): split the platform readings by subject; platform-readings.md becomes their index
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Warren, Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgXFRsfSS1tQB1kBxAZ86579)_
Fixes #35236

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感——只改车队内部的工作手册,产品和对客户发布的内容一行没动。
- 为什么做:车队查一条平台实测事实,要翻一整份四百多行的大表;现在按主题拆成九份小表加一页目录,每次只读手头那一份,读得少、找得准。这是此前同意的技能评审改进顺序的第五步。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某个席位顺着旧指路多翻一页目录;每条事实原样搬过去、一条没删,已逐条比对。整体撤回即完全复原。
- 要你做什么:无(可能已过时的几条读数,另附保留/删除清单单独请你定,不在本次)。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` (458 lines) is split by subject. Every reading moves **verbatim** into nine files beside it; the old file keeps its discipline line and becomes a 14-line index:

| File | Lines | Subject (old line ranges) |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `readings-queue.md` | 89 | queue membership, auto-merge, dequeue, landing (7–89, 359–361, 416) |
| `readings-channels.md` | 76 | quota, REST/MCP/GraphQL channels, token classes, suspension (93–162, 210–213) |
| `readings-page.md` | 21 | zero-quota public page reads (163–181) |
| `readings-search.md` | 43 | dedupe search false zeros, list union and truncation, pagination (182–209, 214–218, 253, 258–264) |
| `readings-issue-fields.md` | 27 | labels, assignees, comment counts, issue type (219–239, 250–252, 254) |
| `readings-write-shapes.md` | 84 | body read artefacts, write-side sanitizer, footers, closing keywords (240–249, 307–358, 402–408, 426–437) |
| `readings-ci.md` | 48 | red checks, the required-check set, gate readings (285–306, 388–401, 410–415, 417–418, 420–421) |
| `readings-shell.md` | 25 | shell and git traps, permission classifier, tooling (265–284, 409, 419, 422) |
| `readings-session.md` | 51 | container restart, probe branches, served tier, harness limits, 5-hour wall (362–387, 423–424, 439–458) |

Pointers: every pointer that named a section of the old file now names the subject file: `SKILL.md` (one line), `os-dev.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `area-lease.md`, `landing-operations.md` (3), `reading-discipline.md`, `rest-channel.md` (6), `triage-duties.md`, `lanes/director.md`, `lanes/server.md`, and the script comments and messages in `post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `rerun-failed.mjs`, `fleet-write/ops.mjs`, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`, `check-half-states.mjs` (comment, message and its H64 pin) and `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (two remedy texts and the pull-back pin). The old file still exists as the index, so a pointer to the file itself still resolves.

Gate wiring that had to follow the content:
- `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`: the `statesTheSet` surface and its self-test `LEDGER_SURFACE` now read `readings-ci.md`, where the eleven required-check names went.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: `platform-readings.md` ceiling 458 → 14 (a lowering); nine new rows at their landed counts, headroom 0; nine `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pins at 0 (no file has a table).

Round 2 (head `803f13aafd`): `rest-channel.md`:64 said "see the quota section" without a file name; that section of the old file is now `readings-channels.md`, and `rest-channel.md` has no section of that name, so the pointer resolved nowhere. It now names `readings-channels.md`, inside the 120-byte line cap (119 bytes) and the file's line ceiling (82, unchanged).

**Look first** (by risk):
1. `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`: the two path swaps, which move the required-check enrolment from the old file to `readings-ci.md`.
2. `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the ten `CEILINGS` rows and nine `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pins.
3. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`:105: the ceiling-raise exception 例外一 now names `readings-*.md` instead of the one old file.

**Two-minute check:** `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` — expect every `readings-*.md` row and the index green at headroom 0, and the cross-file move into `platform-readings.md` reported as paid down (ceiling 14, below the 314 it moved from).

## Possibly stale readings (for the maintainer, not dropped)

All kept verbatim in this PR. They go to the maintainer with the keep/delete list of the current-values card, as one question; nothing here decides them.

1. `readings-shell.md`:14 and `readings-channels.md`:47 say the container has no `gh`. Measured in this cloud container: `command -v gh` answers `/usr/local/bin/gh`.
2. `readings-queue.md`:43–44 and `readings-channels.md`:63 are readings of the ccr route for undraft and arming; line 43 itself says that route is retired (已退役) and undraft and arming go through relay ops.
3. `readings-queue.md`:40 and `readings-write-shapes.md`:42 describe the MCP `update_pull_request` channel, which the lines themselves say lock 1 refuses (「读作历史」).
4. `readings-channels.md`:34–38 and 40 (token classes `claude[bot]` vs user, two dated account flips): fleet writes now land through the relay as the fleet bot, so the signature readings no longer describe the seat write path.
5. `readings-write-shapes.md`:65–66: footers under MCP `issue_write` create and update; seats and devs make no MCP writes now.
6. `readings-channels.md`:29: REST `rerun-failed-jobs` 403 vs MCP 201; re-runs go through the relay's `run_rerun_failed` (`readings-ci.md`:5).
7. `readings-session.md`:37–38: Routine sessions and the `connectors` parameter; line 39 marks it unmeasured (⛔ 未实测).

## Tests

Local gate subset on head `803f13aafd`, derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths; change set from merge base `81c094779`), plus `check-published-list-mirrors` (AGENTS.md is touched) and `check-nul-bytes`: 82 commands, exit codes captured before any pipe.

- 79 of 82 exit 0, among them `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` (self-test + run), `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` (129 files clean), `pnpm check:required-contexts` (self-test 190 assertions; 11 contexts pinned, 5 instruction surfaces scanned), `node scripts/check-published-list-mirrors.mjs` and its `--self-test` (37 cases), `pnpm check:pm-half-states`, `pnpm check:pm-post-stamped`, `pnpm check:pm-label-write`, `pnpm check:pm-fleet-write-dispatch` (dispatch + rerun-failed self-tests), `pnpm check:pm-fleet-write-execute`, `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`, `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync`.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`, run detached: `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 2249 cases pass; 9 slow section(s) deferred`, 494.4 s, exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (no build in this worktree; CI builds first): `check:doc-formula-expressions` (`@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt) and `check:i18n-coverage` (CLI unbuilt). Neither reads a file this PR changes.
- Exit 1, not from this diff: `check:platform-checklist` — `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix: VARIANTS STALE — SeedMode ... now has 0 members`, a reading of an unbuilt `packages/spec`. This PR touches no spec or checklist file, and CI's `Platform checklist gate sweep` and `Lint & Repo Gates` are green on this head.

CI on `803f13aafd` at the time of writing: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Platform checklist gate sweep`, `PR-body guards` success; `Test Core` in progress; Build Core and the UI build lanes skipped by the selector.

## Acceptance notes

- **Corpus size:** 458 lines before, 478 after (+20): one title and one blank per new file, plus the index. A run now reads one file of at most 89 lines instead of the 458-line table. The existing cross-file move into `platform-readings.md` reads "paid down" because its destination fell to 14.
- **Ruled-raise exception:** `triage-duties.md`:105 (例外一) now names `readings-*.md`. Its `ruledRaises` record still sits on the `platform-readings.md` move entry in the ratchet; where a future raise on a subject file is booked is left to the byte-ratchet card, which edits the same script.
- **Overlap** (`node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`, head `803f13aafd`): merges cleanly into `origin/main` and with #35335; #34110 conflicts on `triage-duties.md` (its own edit near line 105). The byte-ratchet card (#35229) edits `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` and queues behind this PR by design; whichever lands second re-applies its rows.
- **Ratchet booking deferred to the byte-ratchet card:** the missing per-file `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` declarations for the readings split and the stale 444-line paid-down credit on the `platform-readings.md` declaration (contract review S2) are recorded as owed by #35229 when it re-measures after this PR lands — comment 7001508654.
- **Left unchanged on purpose:** literal paths of the old file in `check-governed-merges.mjs`:7001 and `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`:3696 (records of a past PR's file list) and :5436 (a Tier S path fixture); the historical ruling quotations and ceiling records in `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`; and its comment at :1219 ("the policy lives in platform-readings.md's quota section"), which reaches the policy through the index. The file still exists, so these stay true.

## Verification

<details><summary>Verbatim move — every reading byte-identical</summary>

Sorted multiset of non-blank lines, old file (at merge base `81c094779`; unchanged on `origin/main` since) against the nine files plus the index: 447 old, 463 new. Only in old: the title and the three section headings (`## 队列成员资格与 auto-merge`, `## API 配额`, `## 读数陷阱`). Only in new: the nine file titles, the index title, and the index's lead line and nine list rows. Every other line matches byte for byte. Item-level check (a bullet with its continuation lines as one unit): 439 old items, 0 missing, 0 changed; the 10 extra are the index's own lines.

</details>

<details><summary>Pointers resolve</summary>

`git grep platform-readings` after the round-2 fix: the index's own line in `reading-discipline.md`, the historical records and fixtures listed under Acceptance notes, and the ratchet's ceiling rows and ruling quotations. No hit names a section the index no longer holds except the ratchet comment at :1219 (left, see above). `git grep` for the old section names (`配额段`, `队列段`, `读数陷阱`, `队列成员资格与 auto-merge`) outside verbatim ruling quotations: none after the fix. Every `readings-*.md` name a pointer uses is one of the nine files, and each swapped pointer was read against the file it now names (dequeue and arming readings in `readings-queue.md`, token classes and the red window in `readings-channels.md`, the bare `#N` expansion and footer shapes in `readings-write-shapes.md`, the log-first rule and re-runs in `readings-ci.md`, served tier in `readings-session.md`, the payload tier in `readings-page.md`).

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod — no schema touched.
- [x] 2. No new names beyond the file names.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch, one pull request.
- [x] 5. Nothing published (`.claude/**`, root scripts, `AGENTS.md`) ⇒ `skip-changeset`; both declaration lines filled.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` untouched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to generated docs, changelogs or release pages.
- [x] 8. English, apart from the maintainer brief and verbatim quotes.
